rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when finding something lost or forgotten again.

example.english: I finally managed to rediscover my old photo album in the drawer.
example.traditional: 我終於喺櫃桶入面搵返本舊相簿喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 hai2 gwai6 tung2 jap6 min6 wan2 faan2 bun2 gau6 soeng2 bou2 laa3

rows.note: Use this especially for regaining an abstract thing such as faith, confidence, or interest.

example.english: After the trip, I managed to rediscover my confidence in life.
example.traditional: 旅行之後，我重拾咗對生活嘅信心。
example.jyutping: leoi5 hang4 zi1 hau6 ngo5 cung4 sap6 zo2 deoi3 saang1 wut6 ge3 seon3 sam1

rows.note: Use this when discovering a quality, fact, or aspect anew rather than physically finding something again.

example.english: Studying this history let me rediscover the value of traditional crafts.
example.traditional: 研究呢段歷史，令我重新發現傳統工藝嘅價值。
example.jyutping: jin4 gau3 ne1 dyun6 lik6 si2 ling6 ngo5 cung4 san1 faat3 jin6 cyun4 tung2 gung1 ngai6 ge3 gaa3 zik6
